title: RoadMap
description: А lightweight and high-performance client-side mod for Fabric, designed for convenient navigation in the world of Minecraft. It adds a functional minimap and an information panel to the player's screen.
body:
# 🧭 RoadMap — Smooth & Clean Direction HUD

RoadMap is a lightweight, performance-focused utility mod for **Fabric** that adds a clean, customizable directional HUD to your screen. Whether you are exploring massive open worlds, navigating tight cave systems, or coordinating with team members in multiplayer, RoadMap ensures you always know exactly where you are heading.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Real-time Direction Tracking:** A precise and responsive compass overlay that updates instantly as you look around or move.
* **Modern Typography:** Uses high-legibility, smooth fonts that scale perfectly across all monitor resolutions without pixelation.
* **Fully Customizable:** Don't like where it is? Want it smaller? You can tweak everything to match your personal HUD style.
* **Zero Performance Impact:** Built with optimization at its core. It hooks directly into the rendering loop without dropping a single frame.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

RoadMap works perfectly out of the box, but it creates a config file upon the first launch so you can tailor it to your needs. You can easily adjust:

* **Visibility:** Toggle the entire HUD overlay on or off.
* **UI Scaling:** Change the text size so it doesn't clutter your screen.
* **Screen Alignment:** Place the overlay anywhere (Top Center, Top Left, Bottom Right, etc.).
* **Update Frequency:** Customize how often the heading recalculates for ultimate smoothness.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Make sure you have the latest version of **Fabric Loader** installed.
2. Put the downloaded `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game! The configuration file will be automatically generated in your `config` directory.

---

## 🛡️ Compatibility

* Fully compatible with standard performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, etc.).
* Designed for client-side use (you don't need it installed on the server to work).
